query:
SELECT
                template,
                COUNT(*)::bigint AS "count!: i64",
                COALESCE(AVG(duration_seconds)::float, 0.0) AS "avg_duration_seconds!: f64",
                MAX(created_at) AS "last_preview_at?"
            FROM studio_preview_events
            WHERE session_id = $1
            GROUP BY template
            ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
